sevenGenius.shortDesc: Data processing app for the 'Itajaí Challenge' competition, using NLP algorithms.
sevenGenius.longDesc: Application developed for the regional 'Itajaí Challenge' competition, where teams solve challenges based on local history and culture. The system processes challenge data, streamlining puzzle-solving and optimizing the participant experience. Uses NLP techniques for text analysis and task automation.

rescueStick.shortDesc: Professional bootable system for operating system recovery and repair.
rescueStick.longDesc: RescueStick v1.0.0 is a professional USB bootable system based on Debian Linux, designed specifically for IT technicians. Offers 7 essential tools in C++ and Python: Windows password reset, disk backup and recovery, hardware diagnostics, boot repair, file recovery, and malware scan. Complete project with 100% test coverage, MIT license, modular architecture, and modern institutional website with optimized SEO.

prozes.shortDesc: CLI tool for scaffolding production-ready Python projects with Flask, FastAPI, and Django.
prozes.longDesc: Powerful CLI tool that generates production-ready Python projects in seconds. Supports Flask, FastAPI, and Django with modern architectures (MVC, REST API, Clean Architecture). Includes real test cases, automated virtual environment setup, dependency installation, and CI/CD workflows. Available on PyPI with multilingual support.

spotifyMancer.shortDesc: System for analyzing musical tastes, managing playlists, and recommendations using Spotify data.
spotifyMancer.longDesc: Application inspired by Spotify Wrapped, but with expanded features, including detailed analysis of musical tastes, personalized recommendations, and AI usage for advanced insights. Allows playlist management and usage statistics exploration.

hrManager.shortDesc: Employee and team management system for HR departments.
hrManager.longDesc: Complete application for people and team management, with features for employee data control, evaluations, reports, and integration with other corporate systems. Focused on facilitating the daily work of HR managers.

financialManager.shortDesc: Financial manager and investment calculator for individuals and businesses.
financialManager.longDesc: System for personal and business financial control, with revenue/expense dashboards, investment recommendations based on user profile, and integration with modern databases. Focus on usability and automatic insights.
